summary: {person} asks which building was serviced when the timecard names only the park.
realLife: Seattle added individual restroom assets to its maintenance system, but managers said workers did not consistently charge time to each facility.
gates: A park with multiple facilities and work records at more than one level of detail.
weights: A repair dispute raises the value of a building-specific entry.
inGame: needs: facility asset ID, parent park ID and the work order’s charged location.

turns.what: The clerk links the repair to the correct facility.
turns.pulledBy: The work order names the building.
